areas.title: Start here
areas.intro: Learn the mission and the big picture of the platform before you read the code.

repos.name: treetracker-api
repos.description: The core Treetracker API: captures, trees, grower accounts, and tags. Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ.

repos.name: treetracker-query-api
repos.description: The read API that serves map and client data: captures, growers, organizations, and trees. Node.js, Express.

repos.name: images-api
repos.description: The image service: it fetches remote images and resizes them. Node.js, Express, Sharp.

repos.name: treetracker-wallet-api
repos.description: The wallet service: wallets, trust relationships, and token transfers. Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL.

repos.name: treetracker-wallet-app
repos.description: The wallet app monorepo: a Next.js web wallet, an Expo mobile wallet, and a NestJS backend.

repos.name: treetracker-wallet-admin-client
repos.description: The admin panel for the wallet service. React, Material UI.

repos.name: treetracker-admin-client
repos.description: The admin panel to verify, process, and manage the tree data that the app collects. React, Material UI.

repos.name: treetracker-admin-api
repos.description: The legacy API for the admin panel. TypeScript, LoopBack 4, PostgreSQL.

repos.name: treetracker-web-map-client
repos.description: The public web map of trees, planters, organizations, and tokens. Next.js, React, Leaflet.

repos.name: treetracker-tile-server
repos.description: A fork of node-mapnik. The Greenstand part is the tile server that renders the web map tiles from PostGIS.

repos.name: treetracker-android
repos.description: The Android app: growers capture trees (photo and GPS) offline and sync them later. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose.

repos.name: treetracker-field-data
repos.description: The service that owns the raw tree data that devices upload. Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL.

repos.name: treetracker-airflow-dags
repos.description: The Apache Airflow pipelines: data export, migration, reports, and map precompute. Python.

repos.name: treetracker-infrastructure
repos.description: The infrastructure as code: Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and observability on DigitalOcean and AWS. Terraform.

repos.name: Greenstand-Overview
repos.description: The org overview and onboarding repo: contributor guide, roadmap, and team directory. Docs, not code.
repos.note: Some of its information is out of date.
